answer_summary: The equilibrium mass balance gives q_e = 427 mg g^-1. Atom counting and pore sharing give COF-9 = C36H27N9O3 per pore (M = 633.666 g mol^-1), so the exact nominal uptake is 45095897/45005000 = 1.0020197089... uranyl ions per pore, reported as 1.00 ions per pore.
assumptions: The printed experimental decimals are used as exact nominal values; no uncertainty interval is asserted.
The standard adsorption mass balance q_e = (c_0 - c_e)V/m is used.
The displayed honeycomb topology is counted with each tritopic vertex shared among three pores and each edge among two pores.
The displayed conversion of each nitrile to an amidoxime adds one NH2OH, and all three pictured nitriles per pore formula unit are converted.
The molar mass of UO2^2+ is calculated from the printed U and O atomic masses; ionic electron-mass differences are ignored by standard chemical molar-mass convention.
